cli.description: Swiss-army-knife CLI for quality checks on static websites.

init.description: Interactively configure vortix for this project

config.description: Adjust vortix settings for this project

check.description: Run checks locally with a human-readable report

ci.description: Run checks non-interactively — JSON output + exit code for automation

errors.outputDirMissing: Output directory "{dir}" does not exist after the build. Check target.outputDir in .vortix/config.json.
errors.noPagesFound: No HTML pages found in "{dir}" — nothing to check. This usually means target.outputDir is misconfigured or the build produced no output.
errors.noGeneratorOutputDir: No static site generator detected. Set target.outputDir manually in .vortix/config.json.
errors.noGeneratorBuildCommand: No static site generator detected. Set target.buildCommand manually, or build: false if the output is already built.
errors.pageCrashed: Page "{url}" could not be loaded for dynamic checks: {message}

progress.playwrightMissing: Playwright browsers not installed — run `npx playwright install chromium`
progress.liveNoUrl: no live URL given — run `vortix check <url>` (or `vortix ci <url>`) to include this check

init.noGeneratorDetected: No known static site generator detected.
init.pickFailOn: At which severity level should `vortix ci` fail?
init.abortedKept: Aborted — existing config was not changed.
init.done: Configuration saved to .vortix/config.json. Get started with: {cmd}
init.pickGithubWorkflow: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs `vortix ci` on every push and pull request?
init.githubWorkflowSkipped: Skipped — existing workflow was not changed.

config.noConfig: No config found. Let's set one up.

report.header: Vortix — adapter: {adapter} · static checks: {totalPages} pages · dynamic checks: {pagesChecked}/{totalPages} pages
report.scoreCappedNote: capped at C: at least one error-level finding
report.scorePartialPagesNote: based on {pagesChecked}/{totalPages} pages — some dynamic checks (accessibility, performance, console errors, tracking, fonts) were skipped. Use `vortix check` for a full-site score.
report.scoreLiveSkippedNote: live checks (security headers, HTTPS, cookies, ...) were skipped — pass a URL to include them, e.g. `vortix check https://example.com`.
report.copyFailed: Could not copy report to clipboard — no clipboard utility found (install xclip, xsel, or wl-copy on Linux)
report.detailNoValues: No measured values reported by this check.
